With `replyInBlocks`, a long block of Claude's reply now comes out whole instead of a screenful at a time.

- 0.51.0 sent a block taller than about 60% of the screen out in pieces, with nothing on screen between them: once text is showing, Claude Code hides the spinner, and the `⋯ gathering the rest` chip in the band was too far away to notice
- Now the spinner shows how many lines it holds until the block is complete, then the whole block appears at once; a block taller than the screen leaves the view at its end, so scroll up to read its start
- The `⋯ gathering the rest` chip is gone
- `/desk-update` from 0.52.0 reloads the plugins for you after updating to this version

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
